eslint_missing: ESLint is not installed in the project ({detail}). Install it with: npm install --save-dev eslint (or point JGATES_ESLINT to the executable).
eslint_no_version: Could not read the ESLint version at {path}. Reinstall with: npm install --save-dev eslint.
eslint_no_config: The instance {tool} has no eslint.config in the component or above it. Create the file or declare tools.{tool}.config in .jgates/tools.yml.
eslint_timeout: ESLint exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended.
eslint_invalid_output: The ESLint report is not the expected JSON: {detail}
eslint_no_invocation: The plan has no ESLint invocation for the instance {tool}.
eslint_condition_executes: Executes project code: the eslint.config and its plugins run during the analysis. That is why the stage is never reused from the cache.
eslint_condition_config_binding: Uses the eslint.config chosen in the binding: {file}.
eslint_condition_config_native: Uses the eslint.config that ESLint itself finds: {file}.
eslint_condition_inline: In local mode ESLint respects the configuration comments in the code (eslint-disable); governed mode (jgates ci) ignores them.
